text:
Priya K: Acme POC hits 403 only when routed through their corporate proxy. Direct calls to api.redwood.dev succeed. Anyone seen proxies strip X-Redwood- headers?
Alex S: Is the 403 from our auth? Paste failing curl (key redacted) + request-id.
Priya K: repro: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp" "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate"

< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"invalid_org_claim","message":"org claim missing or mismatched"}
x-request-id: rq_acme_42

Alex S: error implies org claim missing on our side. Can we get LB/backend logs for rq_acme_42?
Jin L: check if their proxy (Zscaler/nginx/Edge) normalizes or drops custom headers. Zscaler frequently strips underscore headers.
Priya K: customer confirms Zscaler + internal nginx forward proxy. I pulled their nginx access log — X-Redwood-Org is not present in the upstream request:
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.dev
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
User-Agent: curl/7.88.1
# no X-Redwood-Org header

Alex S: yep proxy removed it. Short-term options: 1) ask them to allowlist our header (preferred), 2) use hyphenated header X-Redwood-Org (some proxies drop underscores), 3) issue a short-lived scoped API key bound to org so header not needed.
Jin L: also watch header casing/normalization and WAF rules. Quick debug: tcpdump on LB to confirm exactly what arrives.
Priya K: they need a fast workaround for the demo and can't change proxy policy today. Can we generate a temporary scoped key bound to acme-corp for the POC?
Alex S: yes — we can mint a demo key with org binding and 24h expiry. I'll generate and DM the key. Please record it as a temporary exception.
Sam R: fine as long as billing/trial limits are enforced. Put a note in the deal tracker and mark expiry.
deploy-bot: created api_key_demo_acme_202310 (expires in 24h)
Jin L: I'll write a short KB: "Proxy header forwarding — nginx/Envoy examples" with nginx proxy_set_header lines, Envoy header_transformation snippets, tcpdump grep (grep -i "x-redwood-org"), and fallback patterns (scoped key, org-in-jwt, org-subdomain). We'll add it under docs/networking/troubleshooting.
Priya K: customer validated demo flow with the temporary key. They will schedule a network change window next week to allowlist headers for production. Closing for now; reopen if 403s return. Thanks all :thumbsup:
